name: Lanterns of Moonwood
description: Gather five lost lanterns and evade the wolves to awaken the hill shrine.

then.text: Collect 5 golden lanterns. Avoid the wolves, then climb to the blue shrine.
The forest claimed your light. Try again.
Five lights restored. Moonwood is safe!
The shrine needs all five lanterns. Return when your lights are gathered.
All five lanterns found! Follow the trail uphill to the blue shrine.
